name: Claude Auto-Approve MCP
description: Automatically approves or blocks specified MCP tool calls in Claude Desktop by injecting JavaScript that restores granular per-chat approval control. Provides configurable permanent approvals while maintaining security through per-server tool whitelists and blacklists.
